name: Clear Water - See Underwater
summary: Removes the blue fog overlay when you swim underwater, so you can see clearly. The water surface stays vanilla.
body:
**Clear Water - See Underwater** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It removes the blue fog overlay that covers your screen when you swim underwater, so you can see clearly.

### What it changes
- Removes the underwater fog overlay (the blue murk that hides everything)
- The water surface itself is NOT changed - it stays exactly vanilla

### Why players use it
- To see ores, mobs and the seabed clearly while swimming
- To find underwater caves, shipwrecks and treasure without the blue fog

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition). Client-side only.

---

Part of the **PvP Essentials** family: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low). Support the work on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/fliflight).
